title: Disable automatic Time Machine backups
summary: Turn off automatic backups for your Mac using the command line. This stops Time Machine from running in the background.

steps.explain: Run this command to disable automatic Time Machine backups. You need administrator privileges.

rollback.explain: To undo this change and re-enable automatic backups, run this command.

warnings: Disabling backups means your files will not be automatically saved. Ensure you have another backup method if needed.
